subject: DPA pathway decision + security questionnaire kickoff (controller/processor clarify)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
To: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@finovexa.com>, Tom Briggs <tbriggs@finovexa.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + DPA/SCC decision points and SQ kickoff

Thanks again for taking the call this morning — appreciate the thorough product walkthrough. Short recap and suggested next steps so we can keep momentum on contracting and security intake: 

1) DPA / controller-processor decision
- You indicated Finovexa expects to act as the data controller for customer PII; Redwood would therefore be the processor. Please confirm with your LegalOps team and let us know if there are any use-case exceptions (e.g., Finovexa-owned analytics where roles flip).

2) SCC module selection
- If Finovexa is controller and Redwood is processor, our standard path is the SCC "Processor Module" (we can provide both processor and controller module text if needed).

3) SOC 2 / HIPAA status
- Attached is a short SOC 2 summary (SOC2-type2-summary-2025.pdf). We are SOC 2 Type II compliant for our inference platform (scope: hosting + model serving). For HIPAA: we support BAAs for eligible customers — if you have regulated PHI flows, flag that now so we can route to the Privacy team.

4) Vendor Security Questionnaire (SQ)
- Attached is our standard vendor questionnaire template (RI_Security_Questionnaire_Template.pdf). If you prefer, we can answer your questionnaire in Excel and return within 5 business days once we have the list of required owners.

5) Mutual Action Plan (MAP)
- I've attached a draft MAP (Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx) with suggested owners and dates. Proposed milestones: Legal review of DPA/SCC (2w), questionnaire completed (5 business days), SOC2 evidence uploaded to secure drive (upon signature).

Next steps
- Can you confirm controller/processor expectation with LegalOps and confirm whether HIPAA is in-scope?
- If yes to HIPAA, tell us the specific PHI pathway so we can pull the right controls.
- Request: please share your security questionnaire (or confirm you want us to fill our template) and a target date for returning it.

Thanks — looping in Priya (legal/compliance) and Marissa (CS lead) to help coordinate evidence and contract questions.

--
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.inference
(415) 555-0147
From: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@finovexa.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.inference>
Cc: Tom Briggs <tbriggs@finovexa.com>, Legal Ops <legal@finovexa.com>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + DPA/SCC decision points and SQ kickoff

Thanks Karthik — helpful recap. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

- LegalOps prelim: Finovexa expects to be the controller for product usage data and customer-provided PII, but we have a small analytics pipeline where we may act as joint controller. I'll confirm the final stance with Legal Ops (cc'd).
- HIPAA: Not part of our initial pilot; however, if we expand to provider integrations later this year, we'll need HIPAA controls. For now mark HIPAA as potential future scope.

On evidence: we received your SOC2 summary — good to have. Legal Ops would still like the SOC 2 Type II attestation or an auditor letter if available; the summary is a good start.

Questionnaire: we'll send our vendor security questionnaire (VSA template) to you by end of day Monday. Can you confirm turnaround if we send it Monday (how quickly can you return answers)? Also please confirm who on your side will own the questionnaire (contact for follow-ups).

Appreciate the MAP — I'll review with Tom and Legal Ops and come back with suggested dates.

Best,
Elena Martinez
Head of Product & Partnerships, Finovexa
elena.martinez@finovexa.com
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.inference>
To: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@finovexa.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + DPA/SCC decision points and SQ kickoff

Hi Elena / Tom — Priya here from Redwood Legal/Privacy. Thanks for the quick turnaround. A few clarifying points from our side to make the DPA/SCC conversation efficient: 

- Controller/Processor mapping: if Finovexa is controller and Redwood is processor, we'll propose the SCC Processor Module. If Finovexa is a joint controller for a subset of analytics, we will need a short addendum that documents responsibilities for those features (data retention, subject requests).
- Documents we can provide immediately: draft DPA (processor configuration), SCC module text for processor, and a redline-ready PS/MSC excerpt if needed.
- SOC2 evidence: we can provide the full attestation under NDA; SOC2 summary PDF is attached for initial review. If Legal Ops needs the auditor letter or full report, we can schedule an evidence share once an NDA/MAP step is agreed.

Suggested next steps and owners:
- Finovexa LegalOps confirms controller vs joint-controller scope (Elena / Legal Ops) — target: Tue, 26 May
- Finovexa sends VSA template (Tom) — target: Mon, 25 May
- Redwood returns completed questionnaire (Karthik / Security) — target: 5 business days from receipt
- Legal exchange: DPA + SCC processor module for review (Priya) — target: 2 business days after controller confirmation

If it helps, we can separate the HIPAA conversation into a later addendum so it doesn't block the pilot contracting.

--
Priya Natarajan
Head of Privacy & Legal, Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.inference
From: Tom Briggs <tbriggs@finovexa.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.inference>, Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@finovexa.com>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + DPA/SCC decision points and SQ kickoff

Appreciate the fast responses. Quick confirmations from my side: 
- We'll send the VSA template Monday and expect Redwood's answers within 5 business days — that timeline works for us.
- For the MAP, we want milestone dates in the spreadsheet. Can you propose specific target dates for each owner (legal review, questionnaire return, signature)? I'd like to lock a two-week window for contracting if possible.

If you can indicate a firm deadline for the questionnaire turnaround (we'll aim to review internally within 3 business days once we receive your answers), that will help coordinate LegalOps.

Thanks — looking forward.

Tom Briggs
Director, Procurement, Finovexa
tbriggs@finovexa.com
(617) 555-0981
